entities.name: Archduke Maximilian of Austria-Este
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Archduke Maximilian Joseph of Austria-Este was the fourth son of Archduke Ferdinand of Austria-Este and younger brother of Francis IV, Duke of Modena. He was grand master of the Teutonic Knights from 1835 to 1863.
